definition_en: behaving as if you are better or more important than others
core_image: 下巴抬得老高、不看别人的眼
scene: 新来的主管打断了每个人的发言，眼睛只看天花板。His arrogant manner angered the whole team.
sceneCN: 这里 arrogant 是「傲慢的」（第 1 个义项：自视高人一等）；句意是他傲慢的态度激怒了整个团队。

derivatives.zh: arrogant 加名词后缀 -ance，义为「傲慢；自负」
同根动词，义为「僭取；擅夺」，与 arrogant 同出拉丁 rogare

senses.title: Behaving superior to others
senses.definition: showing an exaggerated sense of one's own importance in dealing with people
senses.definitionCN: 待人时表现出夸大的自我重要感
senses.example: The arrogant waiter ignored our requests all evening.
senses.exampleCN: 那个傲慢的服务员整晚不理会我们的要求。
senses.why: Arrogare means to claim for oneself, so the person claims rank nobody granted.
senses.whyCN: arrogare 意为「自取」，此人自行攫取了无人授予的等级。

senses.title: Presumptuous in claims or statements
senses.definition: excessive and unwarranted, said of claims, opinions or statements
senses.definitionCN: 形容断言、观点或言论过分而无依据
senses.example: It was arrogant of him to call every rival stupid.
senses.exampleCN: 他竟说所有对手都蠢，实在狂妄。
senses.why: What one claims for oneself overreaches what is deserved.
senses.whyCN: 自取的东西超出了应得的分寸。

intro.en: Arrogant comes from Latin arrogantem, present participle of arrogare, to claim for oneself.
intro.cn: arrogant 源自拉丁语 arrogantem，即动词 arrogare（自取、擅求）的现在分词。

items.en: The root *reg- is reconstructed as to straighten, rule, source of rogare (ask).
items.cn: 重构词根 *reg- 义为「使正、统治」，是 rogare（请求）的来源（重构形式）。

items.en: Arrogare meant to claim or demand for oneself, from ad plus rogare.
items.cn: 拉丁语 arrogare 意为「为自己索求」，由 ad 加 rogare 构成。

items.en: In Roman law arrogare named the formal claiming of a person or right.
items.cn: 罗马法中 arrogare 指对人身或权利的正式认领。

items.en: Arrogant entered Middle English via Old French with the over-claiming sense.
items.cn: 14 世纪 arrogant 经古法语进入中古英语，携带「僭越自取」义。

items.en: Today arrogant is a standard term for disdainful superiority in manner.
items.cn: 现代英语中 arrogant 是形容举止居高临下的常用词。

note.en: The arrog- family is about claiming; the -ant adjective judges the claim excessive.
note.cn: arrog- 词族围绕「自取」；-ant 形容词判定这种自取过分。

entries.definition: to claim or take without right
entries.definitionCN: 僭取、擅夺，arrogant 的同根动词

entries.definition: to repeal or abolish a law
entries.definitionCN: 废除（法令），同出 rogare 词根但义为「废除」
芳香的，词首拼写相近但词义无关
倨傲轻蔑的，与 arrogant 义近而更重神情
自负的，侧重自我陶醉的内心

entries.definition: behaving as if superior to others
entries.definitionCN: 目空一切的，书面语色彩更浓

normalIntro.en: Break the word into ar- + rog- (ask) + -ant to see the claim.
normalIntro.cn: 把词拆成 ar- + rog-（求）+ -ant 就能看到「自取」。

normal.en: ad + rogare = to ask for oneself: claiming more than due.
normal.cn: ad + rogare ＝为自己索求：索要超出应得之物。

normal.en: The noun is arrogance: sheer arrogance.
normal.cn: 名词是 arrogance：十足的傲慢。

normal.en: Haughty faces, arrogant words: pair them in your mind.
normal.cn: 倨傲的神情、狂妄的言辞：脑中配对记忆。

normal.en: Arrogantly is the adverb: answer arrogantly.
normal.cn: 副词是 arrogantly：傲慢地回答。

abstract.en: Picture a man leaning back so far his chair tips.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人往后仰靠，椅子都快翻了。

abstract.en: Hear a voice that never asks a question, only issues verdicts.
abstract.cn: 聆听从不起疑、只下断语的声音。

abstract.en: See a crown placed on one's own head, uninvited.
abstract.cn: 想象一顶王冠被自己擅自戴上头。

examples.en: Her arrogant dismissal of the proposal cost the team a week.
examples.cn: 她傲慢地否决提案，让团队白费了一周。

examples.en: He grew arrogant after his first success.
examples.cn: 初次成功之后他变得自大起来。

examples.en: The arrogant tone of the letter offended the committee.
examples.cn: 信中狂妄的语气冒犯了委员会。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿罗·根特」——阿罗把鼻子翘得像树根一样高，眼睛斜视众人，一副「阿罗根特」的傲慢相。

root: 拉丁语 ad-（向）+ rogare（请求）→ arrogare（自取）→ arrogantem（自取的）→ 英语 arrogant；同根词 arrogate、abrogate、prerogative。

sensesIntro.en: From self-claiming manner to unwarranted claims in speech.
sensesIntro.cn: 由自取的做派延伸到言辞中无据的断言。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a self-claimed crown nobody granted
core.cn: 核心意象：无人授予却自己戴上的一顶冠

branches.cn: 建立在自取之上的放肆

branches.en: the proud claim inviting a fall

intro.en: The Latin root rogare (ask) builds a family of claiming words.
intro.cn: 拉丁词根 rogare（请求）构成一族「索求」词。

latinIntro.en: Roman legal language kept rogare alive in verbs of formal demanding.
latinIntro.cn: 罗马法律语言使 rogare 在正式索求类动词中延续。
